Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within allowed HTTP access to a Glassfish administrative console on port 10001 with no authentication. A remote attacker can abuse this to execute remote code under the context of the SYSTEM user. Hewlett-Packard has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: Hewlett-Packard IT Executive Scorecard Java Glassfish Admin Console Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
